prompts.ashigaru:
Create a production-ready transparent 4 by 4 sprite-part atlas for a Japanese ASHIGARU SPEARMAN. Use the attached image only as the painted ink/watercolour MATERIAL AND STYLE reference, not its exact component shapes. The new soldier is humble and sturdy, with a low conical straw jingasa, visible adult male face facing RIGHT, weathered charcoal kosode, modest lamellar chest armour, muted ochre headband and belt. Anatomical volume and readable large brush planes, dense opaque charcoal shadows, restrained warm grey highlights; no speckled noise or paper backing.

Every detached limb lies HORIZONTALLY: proximal joint at LEFT, distal joint at RIGHT, both centered vertically. Bone pivot centers at 12% and 88% of each component width. Row 3: same four components for the far side, slightly darker.
Row 4: (1) front sandal and ankle, toe RIGHT, perfectly level sole; (2) far sandal same; (3) long ochre fabric sash strip, knot on right, frayed tip on left; (4) long wood yari spear pointing RIGHT, horizontal.
